description: This PHP source file defines the AttendancePunchInRecordOverlapAPI class, which provides an API endpoint to check for punch-in time overlaps for employees within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It handles GET requests to verify if a punch-in time overlaps with existing records, considering timezone adjustments.
